body:
Your trust means the world to us. This policy explains how we handle your information with care and transparency.

1. Information We Collect
When you place an order or contact us, we collect necessary details such as your Name, Email Address, Shipping Address, and Phone Number. We only ask for information strictly needed to fulfill your order and provide support.

2. How We Use Your Data
Your information is used solely to process and ship your orders, communicate with you regarding your inquiries, and ensure you have a great shopping experience. We never sell or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes.

3. Payment & Data Security
We take data protection seriously. All payments are handled securely through your chosen provider (like GCash or Bank Transfer). For your safety, we never ask for or store your private PINs or passwords. Our systems use secure, modern standards to keep your message and order details private.

4. Your Rights
You can reach out to us at yaaazz.creativeco@gmail.com at any time to request a copy of your data or to ask for its removal from our records.

*Stay creative, stay safe! ✨*
